tools.name: Air-Gapped Jupyter Python
tools.purpose: Kontrollierte Python-Ausführung über lokal/intern konfigurierten Jupyter Server.

tools.name: Ask User
tools.purpose: Allows the LLM to autonomously trigger 1-5 interactive pop-up questions to gather missing project details.

tools.name: ComfyUI Workflow Inspector Offline
tools.purpose: ComfyUI-Workflow-JSON lokal prüfen und Offline-Setup-Checklisten für Visual-/Audio-/Video-Tools erzeugen.

tools.name: Docker Compose Triage
tools.purpose: Docker-Compose- und OpenWebUI-Fehlertexte ohne Containerzugriff analysieren.

tools.name: GitHub Repo Inspector
tools.purpose: Read-only GitHub repository metadata inspection with optional token support through Valves or OpenWebUI OAuth.

tools.name: Inline Visuals Toolkit V3 Offline
tools.purpose: Offline SVG-Charts, HTML-Dashboards, Mermaid-Blöcke und Visual-Briefs ohne externe Assets erzeugen.

tools.name: JSON CSV Text Validator
tools.purpose: JSON, CSV und strukturierte Texte lokal validieren und sensible Felder markieren.

tools.name: LLM Council Tool
tools.purpose: OpenWebUI Workspace Tool.

tools.name: Markdown Skill Builder
tools.purpose: Generate importable OpenWebUI Skill Markdown from safe user goals.

tools.name: MediaWiki Legacy Crawler
tools.purpose: Crawl an internal MediaWiki instance through the MediaWiki API with support for legacy username/password login flows.

tools.name: Offline Artifact Workbench
tools.purpose: Offline HTML-, Präsentations-, PDF- und ZIP-Artefakte in einem erlaubten Artefaktverzeichnis erzeugen.

tools.name: OpenAPI Schema Inspector
tools.purpose: Eingefügte OpenAPI-JSON-Schemas lokal analysieren.

tools.name: OpenUI - Generative UI
tools.purpose: Renders interactive generative UI components (charts, forms, tables, cards, follow-ups) in chat using OpenUI Lang.

tools.name: Offline Parallel Task Planner
tools.purpose: Komplexe Arbeit in dependency-sichere parallele Tool-Wellen und Subagent-Arbeitspakete zerlegen.

tools.name: Parallel Tools
tools.purpose: Execute multiple independent tool calls in parallel for faster results.

tools.name: Repository Tree Analyzer
tools.purpose: Analyze a pasted repository tree or file list without server-side filesystem reads.

tools.name: Safe HTTP Fetcher
tools.purpose: Bounded HTTP GET and HEAD inspection for public URLs with SSRF protections.

tools.name: Sub Agent
tools.purpose: Run autonomous, tool-heavy tasks in a sub-agent and keep the main chat context clean.

tools.name: Subagent Orchestrator
tools.purpose: Build OpenWebUI-ready subagent rosters, delegation prompts and result merges for agentic offline workflows.

tools.name: Tool Skill Overlay Planner
tools.purpose: Modellbezogene Tool-/Skill-Overlays, Redundanz und Fallback-Abdeckung planen.

tools.name: Visuals Toolkit V4
tools.purpose: Tables, charts, heatmaps, timelines, flowcharts, trees, dashboards, metric grids, pie/donut charts, gauges, Gantt charts, Sankey diagrams, radar charts, waterfall charts, funnels, and candlestick charts. Dark-mode-safe HTML with Plotly, auto-resizing iframes, and fullscreen support. Pure ASCII/Markdown fallback when HTML is unavailable.

tools.name: Web Search and Crawl
tools.purpose: Search and crawl local/self-hosted sources using SearXNG, OpenWebUI Native Search, and Crawl4AI. Public network access is blocked by default for Air-Gap operation.
